mapper.sql: pr.id AS request_id, pr.request_number, pr.title, pr.status, applicant.display_name AS applicant_name, COALESCE(pr.department_name_snapshot, department.name) AS department_name, pr.desired_delivery_date, COALESCE(item_summary.total_amount, 0)::BIGINT AS total_amount, pr.updated_at

JOIN users applicant ON applicant.id = pr.applicant_id JOIN departments department ON department.id = pr.department_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE( SUM( COALESCE(item.quantity, 0)::BIGINT * COALESCE(item.planned_unit_price, 0) ), 0 )::BIGINT AS total_amount FROM request_items item WHERE item.request_id = pr.id ) item_summary ON TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*)::BIGINT AS count FROM purchase_requests WHERE applicant_id = #{applicantId} GROUP BY status ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN 1 WHEN 'SUBMITTED' THEN 2 WHEN 'REAPPLICATION_REQUIRED' THEN 3 WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 4 WHEN 'ORDERED' THEN 5 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 6 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 7 WHEN 'CANCELED' THEN 8 ELSE 99 END

SELECT
FROM ( SELECT candidate.* FROM purchase_requests candidate JOIN approver_department_scopes candidate_scope ON candidate_scope.department_id = candidate.department_id AND candidate_scope.user_id = #{approverId} WHERE candidate.status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY candidate.submitted_at ASC NULLS LAST, candidate.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) pr
ORDER BY pr.submitted_at ASC NULLS LAST, pr.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVED')::BIGINT AS awaiting_order_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'ORDERED')::BIGINT AS awaiting_receipt_count FROM purchase_requests WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'ORDERED')

SELECT
FROM ( SELECT candidate.* FROM purchase_requests candidate WHERE candidate.status IN ('APPROVED', 'ORDERED') AND candidate.desired_delivery_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY candidate.desired_delivery_date ASC, candidate.updated_at ASC, candidate.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) pr
ORDER BY pr.desired_delivery_date ASC, pr.updated_at ASC, pr.id ASC
